description: The quality-model certification levels — lifecycle states of a SCOPED claim, never universal professional ratings. The grant vocabulary is DEVELOPMENT | CANDIDATE | CERTIFIED; CONDITIONAL is derived from declared constraints; REVOKED is never granted by a run (it is the effective state of a prior claim after an append-only revocation).

grantable.description: True for DEVELOPMENT | CANDIDATE | CERTIFIED (the grant vocabulary).
